g.text: Coverage and missingness: every original model-condition cell
Original primary cohort only: 896 attempts; 890 valid graphs; 6 terminal failures.
Cell text: defined endpoints / attempts; F = terminal failures; U = valid graphs with undefined endpoint.
Blue intensity is the defined fraction (0-1); exact counts carry the information. Valid empty graphs are not failures.
